title: PowerPoint on desktop: attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says licensing is the only documented control governing this feature. Microsoft documents connected-experience privacy controls that disable Copilot features in PowerPoint; the narrower statement that no image-attachment-specific switch is documented is supported. The roadmap facts, user steps and licence-assignment controls are supported.
